name: launch-simple
about: The default launch film, 15-30 s, played as a spine: one sentence as 3-5 acts, one case (the brief's request, names and numbers in every act), one element whose form changes act to act and is handed on at every scene change (src/timeline.ts HANDOVER_PLAN, drawn by fx/Handover), lines alone only for the promise and the claim (inside the product's words or around the element between), a designed world lit in the brand's hue that takes one step per act and turns once (src/world.tsx), the lockup grown out of the last form. The agent writes src/spine.ts first, then src/content.ts (scripts/content.mjs) and src/product.tsx (house scenes from src/acts/scenes.tsx: macro-type, page-fly, push-press, toast-stack, glass-counter, the lockup); the timeline, the handovers, the world steps and the sound plan follow.

beats.acts: 3-5 acts on whole bars (first 20-32 %, last 12-31 %), each one verb of the sentence with 1-3 states of the element (src/spine.ts)
beats.handover: every scene change: the element carried (grow, swell, fly, converge, same-surface ...; lib/spine FORM_PAIRS), never a bare cut inside an act
beats.lines: alone only for the promise (act 1, its key word becoming the element) and the claim; inside the product's own words or around the element between; at most four
beats.end: the mark grows out of the last form (a converge, a swell, a pull-out), the name slides out from behind it, the one fact under it; held 2-2.5 s, creeping

deal.seed: the deck's direction (deck.py --direction <id> --why: src/dealt.ts), else the product's name

music.about: Every launch is cut to a licensed, human-made, instrumental track (references/music.md): the track carries the film, the effects are cut to the picture (src/sync.ts: every handover by its kind, the keys, the press, the notices, the turn, one hit on the lockup). Any tempo from 90 to 140 BPM fits: the acts sit on whole bars of the track.
music.pick: node scripts/music.mjs pick --mood "<the film's mood words>" --length <s> (a launch here: 115-136 BPM and the film's energy preferred; the curated library; with none, music.mjs search --bpm 115-136), then music.mjs get '#n' --to audio/music (its licence record beside it; never the last film's track)
music.add: bash scripts/new-film.sh <dir> --music <file> --title T --artist A --source S --page URL --licence L --seen-quote Q --seen-url URL --ai-generated no --vocals no, or later: python3 scripts/audio/track.py add <file> ...
then: python3 scripts/audio/track.py fit   (after launch.ts is written: the film's bars, the lockup's bar and the cuts read from the timeline at the track's tempo; the edit plays exactly those bars, lands the entry on the lockup, keeps sections from changing mid-shot, ends on a hit; then src/music.ts)
npm run music fits again after a change to the script or the track

next: simple launch: write the spine first in src/spine.ts (the sentence, the case from the brief, one element, 3-5 acts each with its verb, its forms and scenes, the lines alone only for the promise and the claim, BARS and CLOSE); say it as a chain (A becomes B becomes C) and print the plan (template.json deal.print),
deal: deck.py here (three directions into out/OPTIONS.md), pick the one that fits with --direction <id> --why "<one line>" (src/dealt.ts: the world and the voice),
the content: node scripts/content.mjs --brief BRIEF.md --fetch --force, then read src/content.ts and keep only what is true (look at every picture: the brief's own subject or none),

the scenes: src/product.tsx gives every scene of the spine its house scene (src/acts/scenes.tsx) filled with the case, or a scene of your own from src/kit/screens; real companies' marks from scripts/logos.mjs get,
the mark: scripts/brand.py with the brand's SVG (an invented brand's own mark),
then the music (below), npm run check and grid-check --part spine, npm run sound, the draft (render.sh --draft) and forensics --spine, look-audit --look on it, one review round on its sheet
